dataset.description: Evaluates a model's ability to extract factual knowledge from text. Based on the T-REx dataset which aligns natural language with Wikidata/DBpedia knowledge base triples. dataset.citation: ElSahar et al., 'T-REx: A Large Scale Alignment of Natural Language with Knowledge Base Triples', LREC 2018
